title: Rodrigues Network for Learning Robot Actions

layout.note: Three titled columns left to right: a rounded frame for the classical operator, an identically laid out frame for the learnable operator, and a column of three dashed application cards fed by three short arrows from the second frame.

lesson: To show a learnable generalisation, draw the classical formula and the new operator as mirrored frames with identical layout (tensor stack times vector stack), swap the colour family and replace uniform cells by multicoloured ones, then fan out to application cards.
